notes.subject: Ere-Beti-Eri
notes.rationale: אֵל בֵּית־אֵל: 'Ngai wa Beti-Eri' (KJV, JPS) kana 'kũo kwa Beti-Eri' — thutha wa mũhiano wa 28:19.

notes.subject: nĩmoonĩtwo
notes.rationale: נגלו nĩ 'kũbuaruo/kũonekana' — kĩbumbo kĩarĩrio gĩatũĩka kĩonekero.

notes.subject: kuuma thĩinĩ wa mũrũ wa nyina
notes.rationale: מפני אחיw nĩ 'kuuma keengo-inĩ kwa mũrũ wa nyina' — 'thĩinĩ wa' nĩgũcohania 'enara'.

notes.subject: אל / אליו / בית אל
notes.rationale: Ere ('ngai') na אליו ('kũrĩ iro') na Beti-Eri ciugwo na mĩgambo ĩmwe — mũhianano ũtaũragwo thutha wa rĩĩtwa Ere-Beti-Eri.

notes.subject: iro
notes.rationale: Gĩkũyũ ĩrehithĩria kĩgĩrĩĩro gĩa kũrĩra hĩngĩci ya 'he' — נגלו ĩreka mũndũ warĩ na ũrĩa anamũkĩtie.

translation: Akĩongorerera kũo itĩrĩra rĩa cahĩra, na akĩĩgetha kĩndũ kĩu Ere-Beti-Eri; nĩgũkorwo kũo Erohimu nĩmoonĩtwo kũrĩ iro, rĩrĩa acokire kuuma thĩinĩ wa mũrũ wa nyina.
